questions.question: Which prefix distinguishes a CSS3 pseudo-element from a pseudo-class?
questions.explanation: CSS3 introduced double colons (::) for pseudo-elements (like ::before) to distinguish them from pseudo-classes (:hover).

questions.question: Which property is strictly required for ::before and ::after to appear on the page?
questions.explanation: Without the 'content' property (even if empty: content: ""), ::before and ::after will not be generated in the render tree.

questions.question: Which pseudo-element allows you to style the first character of an editorial article with a large drop-cap?
questions.explanation: ::first-letter applies styles to the first character of the first line of a block container.

questions.question: Which pseudo-element targets the text currently highlighted with a mouse drag by the user?
questions.explanation: ::selection matches the portion of an element that is highlighted by the user.

questions.question: Where does ::before insert its generated content relative to the parent element's actual content?
options: Outside and above the parent container
As the very first child inside the target element before all other content
questions.hint: Inside the element as its first child.
questions.explanation: ::before creates a pseudo-element that is the first child of the selected element, preceding its actual content.
